dedupe_keys.name: pglib opf power grid lib optimal power flow

description: PGLib-OPF, the Power Grid Lib optimal power flow library, is a curated benchmark library of network cases for evaluating algorithms that solve a well-established form of the AC optimal power flow problem, a non-convex nonlinear programme. It is curated and maintained by the IEEE Power and Energy Society Task Force on Benchmarks for Validation of Emerging Power System Algorithms, with an introductory video and an arXiv report explaining its motivation and goals and a separate paper describing the mathematical model. All cases are stored in the MATPOWER data format, and open-source reference implementations with baseline results exist in MATPOWER and PowerModels.jl. The cases come from many sources and sizes, so coverage is a set of test networks, not one country; the data are released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence, with specific copyright holders named in each file, free of charge on GitHub. Caveats: releases are versioned by year (latest tag v23.07) and the repository shows no commit after July 2023, so newer cases are not included; the cases target algorithm benchmarking, not the planning of a real system. Simulation uses are optimisation and network flow method validation. Related records: model-matpower and model-powermodels-jl provide the reference implementations.
